strategies.name: analystFacts
strategies.description: Facts an analyst states about themselves or their work -- which lender they cover, which fraud discipline they own, which applications they are reviewing. Retrieved on later sessions so a returning analyst does not restate them.

strategies.name: caseSummaries
strategies.description: A compressed summary of each review session, so a case picked up tomorrow carries what was already established rather than starting from the application record again.

agentCoreGateways.name: ppfraud-reference
agentCoreGateways.description: Reference-data tools for the fraud agents, MCP-ified behind one endpoint. Today the alert dictionary; the same gateway is where an Aurora or Cortex target goes.
